CORRUPTION FOUND AND HELD BACK, NOT PUBLISHED. The M+ half refreshed normally: 40 rows from specRankingsSection.table.data[] popularity (fraction x100), asOf 07-29. The RAID half is where the problem is: all 40 committed raid "Popularity" rows carry DPS/HPS magnitudes (Outlaw 166000, Mistweaver 211500, Vengeance 88800) under unit "%", byte-identical to that spec's "95th pct DPS (Mythic)" value — i.e. a prior run merged the `dps` column into the Popularity series. This run's live parse of the same field returns the correct percentages (Unholy DK 10.33, Blood DK 28.29, Outlaw 0.52). Publishing that fix would move all 40 rows ~100% and shift the family median, which the value-move guard rejects by design, and there is no agent-writable proposal channel for that gate. So the corrected raid rows were deliberately NOT merged and the corrupt stored values are UNCHANGED — this row is partial, not success, and the raid coverage date stays 2026-07-28. ACTION FOR A HUMAN: re-run this workflow with value_move_ack set (e.g. "Archon raid Popularity column-parse corrected, 40 rows rescaled from DPS magnitudes to percent") and the next run will land the fix. Correct values are reproducible from props.pageProps.page.specRankingsSection.table.data[].popularity on the three raid aggregate pages.
